authority: Ministry of Housing, Communities & Local Government
note: Previously unused official public no-login source window. Planning Data Local plan dataset contains separate rows for current, emerging or historical local plans and can link plans to detailed information; at inspection time it reports 990 local plans from 84 data providers. A bounded window of at most 50 records was considered for the unresolved criterion. The fixed future_growth_3 owner/partition/checkpoint still exposes no authoritative local-plan reference, local-plan-boundary reference, development-plan reference, LPA/LAD identifier or name, organisation code, postcode, UPRN, coordinate/grid reference, or equivalent selector. Selecting any local plan would therefore require guessing. No coverage_area_id is selected, no coverage Polygon/MultiPolygon is emitted, no source-area record is accepted, no parcel is accepted, and no Plan0 package is emitted.
